title: How Has the Data Discussion Evolved Since the Proliferation of AI?
summary: Attending the Communify Intelligence Experience in London, Leon Saunders Calvert, President and Managing Director, Economist Enterprise spoke to FinextraTV to provide insights into how approaches and perceptions towards data have changed. Saunders Calvert said that the importance of data has not changed, but how it can be used and applied has significantly evolved. He mentions many of the opportunities that have arisen since the growth in AI and how this has dramatically transformed the data discussion, and equally the task of sustaining trust and preventing hallucinations. He emphasised the crucial nature of data within decision making and suggested this should remain the basis for how AI is used and applied.
